claims.object_text: zebrafish depdc5 knockout model showing spontaneous epileptiform events, increased drug-induced seizure susceptibility, hypoactivity, premature death, and hyperactivation of mTOR signaling
claims.quote: a zebrafish depdc5 knockout model showing spontaneous epileptiform events in the brain, increased drug-induced seizure susceptibility, general hypoactivity, premature death at 2-3 weeks post-fertilization, as well as the expected hyperactivation of mTOR signaling was developed.

claims.object_text: dysregulation of genes involved in synaptic function, neurogenesis, axonogenesis, and GABA network activity
claims.quote: many genes involved in synaptic function, neurogenesis, axonogenesis, and GABA network activity were found to be dysregulated in larval brains.

claims.object_text: defects in the fine branching of the GABAergic network
claims.quote: immunostaining of depdc5-/- brains for several GABAergic markers revealed specific defects in the fine branching of the GABAergic network.

claims.object_text: treatment with GABA compensates some defects in depdc5-/-
claims.quote: some defects in depdc5-/- could be compensated for by treatment with GABA
the inability of rapamycin to rescue the GABAergic network defects observed in depdc5-/- brains

claims.object_text: GABA does not rescue hypoactivity in another mTOR-hyperactivation model
claims.quote: the inability of GABA to rescue the hypoactivity in another genetic model showing mTOR hyperactivation.

claims.object_text: roles apart from its canonical function as an mTOR inhibitor
claims.quote: DEPDC5 plays previously unknown roles apart from its canonical function as an mTOR inhibitor.

claims.object_text: defective neurodevelopment of GABAergic networks could be a key factor in epileptogenesis
claims.quote: defective neurodevelopment of GABAergic networks could be a key factor in epileptogenesis when DEPDC5 is mutated.
